chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: dark slow-shifting synth fog pad, slightly detuned
a sparse soft heartbeat kick every two bars
one lonely low pulse-wave lead note swelling out of the dark
oppressive hush with a fragile thread of hope
haunting slow three-note rising figure as the hook
spacious and sparse but clearly composed
seamless transition back to the theme
